--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT CRD_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_ISSCARD
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CRD_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CRD_ID ORDER BY [FILE_NAME] DESC, INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* into BUSC.ATM_ISSCARD_WITH_DUP_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_ISSCARD; --Target table to remove duplicate

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN 
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_ISSCARD;

--4 CHECK COUNT DUP TABLE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_ISSCARD_WITH_DUP_20240321;

--5 CREATE BU TABLE
SELECT * INTO BUSC.ATM_ISSCARD_BU_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_ISSCARD;

--6 UPDATE ISLATEST = 0
UPDATE BUSC.ATM_ISSCARD_WITH_DUP_20240321 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1

--7 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.ATM_ISSCARD; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--8 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO BUSC.ATM_ISSCARD --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT
CRD_ID
,CRD_UUID
,CRD_BCR_ID
,CRD_PRS_ID
,CRD_INS_ID
,CRD_BRN_ID
,CRD_NUMBER
,CRD_ISSUE_DATE
,CRD_EXPIRY_DATE
,CRD_PREVIOUS_CRD_ID
,CRD_CARDHOLDER_NAME
,CRD_CREATION_DATE
,CRD_STS_ID
,CRD_STATUS_DATE
,CRD_CREATED_BY
,CRD_CREATED_TS
,CRD_UPDATED_BY
,CRD_UPDATED_TS
,CRD_AUDIT_LOG
,CRD_PARENT_CRD_ID
,CRD_ALLOW_RENEWAL
,CRD_IS_PRIMARY
,CRD_KIT_NUMBER
,CRD_IS_LINKED
,CRD_CTS_ID
,CRD_EMB_ID
,CRD_BRN_ID_ORIGINAL
,CRD_NUMBER_ENC
,CRD_NUMBER_MASKED
,CRD_CCL_ID
,CRD_IS_CARD_POSTED
,CRD_SEQUENCE_NUMBER
,CRD_LIFE_CYCLE
,CRD_PIN_OFFSET
,CRD_PIN_OFFSET_TS
,CRD_IS_CORPORATE
,CRD_CORPORATE_CIF
,CRD_CORPORATE_NAME
,CRD_KEY_ROTATION_NUMBER
,CRD_EMBOSSING_NAME
,CRD_PIN_GENERATED
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
 FROM BUSC.ATM_ISSCARD_WITH_DUP_20240321; -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records

--9 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT CRD_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_ISSCARD
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CRD_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--10 COUNT TARGET
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_ISSCARD;

--11 COUNT DUPS
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_ISSCARD_WITH_DUP_20240321
